description: Use when the user asks to check a site's SSL/TLS certificate, why HTTPS fails or when it expires. Returns trust, name match, expiry, issuer, chain, key and TLS version for port 443, with findings. Ex: 'When does the SSL certificate of example.com expire?'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.

domain.description: A public domain name, e.g. example.com.
